page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead GCP Platform Engineer (Google Gemini Enterprise for CX)
headline: Lead GCP Platform & Conversational AI Engineer | Google Gemini Enterprise, CCaaS, Terraform & DevSecOps
summary_html: Lead GCP Platform & Conversational AI Engineer with 10 years of hands-on experience designing, provisioning, securing, and operating enterprise cloud and customer experience platforms. Proven expertise owning Google Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (CX) ecosystems—including conversational AI agents (Dialogflow CX / Vertex AI Conversation), Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), and conversational analytics across Dev, Test, and Production environments. Expert in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), enforcing environment consistency, drift remediation, and release governance. Highly skilled in integration delivery, connecting CCaaS platforms with CRM (Salesforce), order management, WFM, call recording, payment, and identity systems via Apigee / API Gateway and serverless connectors (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run). Deep compliance foundation enforcing PCI-DSS, PII, and SOX controls across voice and chat streams through tokenization, Cloud IAM least-privilege, CMEK/KMS encryption, Secret Manager, and audit traceability. Proven track record establishing Cloud Monitoring/Logging telemetry across conversational flows and telephony routing, serving as the Tier 2/3 operational escalation point across vendor and internal teams.

achievements.text: Owned the enterprise Google Gemini for CX platform across development, test, and production environments—defining environment promotion strategies, Cloud IAM access governance, and production readiness gates for conversational AI agents and CCaaS.

Led mission-critical integrations between contact center systems and core enterprise platforms (CRM, OMS, WFM, call recording, payment tokenization, and IdP) leveraging Apigee, Google Cloud API Gateway, and Cloud Functions/Cloud Run serverless connectors.

Architected and managed multi-region GCP infrastructure using modular Terraform, Cloud Build, and GitLab CI; implemented automated policy checks and controlled change management procedures to ensure strict multi-environment parity.
Enforced PCI-DSS, PII, and SOX compliance across voice and chat data pipelines with payment tokenization, Cloud KMS (CMEK) encryption, Cloud Secret Manager, and immutable Cloud Audit Logs.

Engineered end-to-end monitoring and alerting across conversational flows, carrier telephony routing, and API endpoints using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, and BigQuery analytics; served as primary Tier 2/3 escalation lead across vendors and internal teams.

experience.title: Lead GCP Platform & Conversational AI Engineer
impact: Owned the enterprise Google Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (CX) platform across dev, test, and production environments, establishing multi-environment strategy, access governance, and strict production readiness reviews for conversational AI agents.

Led integration architecture connecting CCaaS platforms with Salesforce CRM, enterprise order management (OMS), membership/loyalty, workforce management (WFM), and call recording systems utilizing Apigee, Cloud API Gateway, and serverless Cloud Functions/Cloud Run connectors.

Provisioned and automated GCP infrastructure using modular Terraform and Cloud Build/GitLab CI pipelines, establishing automated change validation and drift detection to maintain environment consistency across staging and production.

Enforced PCI-DSS, PII, and SOX controls across voice and chat streams, implementing real-time credit card tokenization, Cloud KMS Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), Cloud Secret Manager, and full audit traceability via Cloud Audit Logs.

Engineered comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems using Google Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging, tracking conversational intent matching, agent deflection rates, carrier telephony routing latency, and API error budgets.

Served as the Tier 2/3 operational escalation lead, collaborating with Google Cloud support, CCaaS telephony providers, and internal application teams to troubleshoot high-priority conversational platform incidents and drive root cause analysis (RCA).
Built automated reporting pipelines streaming conversational telemetry and agent transcripts into BigQuery, powering executive dashboards for contact center analytics and agent performance metrics.

experience.title: Senior Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer
impact: Provisioned and administered Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and cloud infrastructure using Terraform, standardizing containerized deployment templates and namespace resource quotas.
Implemented Cloud IAM least-privilege governance and Workload Identity federation, replacing long-lived service account keys with short-lived tokens across CI/CD runners.

Built automated release pipelines in GitLab CI incorporating automated container vulnerability scanning (Trivy), static code analysis (SonarQube), and gated approval checks for multi-environment promotion.
Integrated automated health checks, ingress routing, and Cloud Monitoring alert policies for high-traffic microservices, improving uptime and deployment predictability.

experience.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer II
impact: Architected and operated enterprise multi-region cloud infrastructure using Terraform, establishing automated provisioning runbooks and disaster recovery failover automation.
Designed secure multi-tier networking, edge traffic distribution, and API routing architectures to handle high-throughput customer-facing services with low latency.
Developed Python operational automation scripts against cloud provider APIs to automate resource inventory tagging, certificate rotation, and security configuration audits.
Implemented robust monitoring, metric aggregations, and automated alert routing, accelerating incident response and reducing mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) for edge services.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Delivered cloud infrastructure platforms using Terraform and Kubernetes supporting real-time transaction processing, logistics tracking, and customer billing workflows.
Implemented stringent PCI-DSS and SOX compliance safeguards across payment pipelines, including credit card data tokenization, KMS secrets encryption, and access control audit trails.
Developed internal platform automation APIs in Python (FastAPI) to integrate ticketing, deployment pipelines, and alerting workflows with cloud infrastructure.
Served as Tier 2/3 operational escalation engineer, configuring Prometheus alerting rules and Grafana dashboards to monitor payment gateway latency and transaction throughput.

experience.title: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer
impact: Supported enterprise connected-vehicle platforms, provisioning cloud infrastructure and configuring multi-tier environments across test, pre-prod, and production.
Partnered with Java development teams to build automated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, configuring Maven build lifecycles and RESTful microservices deployments.
Enforced security and compliance policies aligned to corporate IT standards, implementing least-privilege access, encryption at rest, and audit logging.
Orchestrated release deployment windows, cutover checklists, and cross-team communications for major platform releases.

experience.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
impact: Developed modular Terraform templates and Ansible playbooks to provision and configure multi-environment application infrastructure.
Built end-to-end CI/CD pipelines integrating Jenkins, Git, Maven, and Nexus for building, packaging, and deploying enterprise Java application components.
Automated system administration workflows and configuration enforcement using Python and Shell scripting.
Configured centralized logging and operational dashboards in Splunk to analyze application performance and accelerate deployment troubleshooting.
